name: Akina
source:
A fox spirit at a local shrine. Thanks to the vague wish Koji made about wanting a friend, she is able to show herself to him. After witnessing Koji do something nice for no other reason than because he wanted to, she offers to be his friend, and immediately asks him out on a date!

She is a very cheeky girl who loves to tease Koji at every opportunity. Will he fall for her shenanigans, or will the spirit world get in their way? 

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=158]MangaGamer[/url]]
